extensions.scope: Inherited global tokens and CSS utilities; implemented hero/navigation only. Other page components were not audited. Component snippets are visual extracts without application runtime.
extensions.tonalRampNote: Synthesized OKLCH preview ramps only, retaining source hue/chroma and alpha. These ramps are not implemented palette tokens or approved additional brand colors.

display.purpose: Scoped two-line hero title; 6rem at desktop.

headline.purpose: Existing global section-heading utility; not a page-wide audit.

body.purpose: Existing document body family, weight and leading.

hero-body.purpose: Hero-only short prose; increases to 1.25rem on desktop.

shadows.name: inherited-mobile-menu-cta
shadows.purpose: Existing mobile menu action; not the hero CTA.

motion.name: hero-entrance-ease
motion.purpose: Hero title 700ms, second line delay 80ms; copy 650ms, description/facts delays 100/150ms. Omitted for reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-control
motion.purpose: Hero state changes; transitions removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-video-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal decoded video over the poster.

motion.name: hero-pointer-content
motion.purpose: Inner content only, at most 4px horizontal and 3px vertical; desktop fine mouse only and no reduced motion. Event-driven, no idle loop.

motion.name: navigation-menu
motion.purpose: Compact menu fade and 8px lift; suppressed for reduced motion.

components.name: Amber button — inherited utility
components.description: Existing global display-font button; preserves its inherited glow and browser focus geometry. Not the new hero primary action.
components.css: .ds-amber { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 65)); color: var(--background, oklch(0.1 0.012 55)); font-family: var(--font-display-family, "Bebas Neue", sans-serif); font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.65; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s var(--ease-out-expo, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), transform 0.16s var(--ease-out-expo, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease-out-expo, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } .ds-amber:hover { background: oklch(0.78 0.13 65); box-shadow: 0 0 32px oklch(0.72 0.12 65 / 0.35); } .ds-amber:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-amber:focus-visible { outline-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.72 0.12 65 / 0.5)) 50%, transparent); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-amber { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.name: Ghost button — inherited utility
components.description: Existing global outlined display-font button; amber glow is inherited, not a hero treatment.
components.css: .ds-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.92 0.008 75)); font-family: var(--font-display-family, "Bebas Neue", sans-serif); font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.65; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.72 0.12 65 / 0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease-out-expo, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), transform 0.16s; } .ds-ghost:hover { border-color: oklch(0.72 0.12 65 / 0.8); color: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 65)); box-shadow: 0 0 20px oklch(0.72 0.12 65 / 0.15); } .ds-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.72 0.12 65 / 0.5)) 50%, transparent); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ghost { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.name: Hero primary action
components.description: Pale, high-contrast inquiry anchor. Cursor-driven content translation is runtime behavior documented in DESIGN.md, not simulated here.
components.html: Overiť dostupnosť
components.css: .ds-hero-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 56px; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--hero-ink, oklch(0.97 0.007 75)); color: var(--hero-dark, oklch(0.12 0.01 55)); font-family: var(--font-body-family, "Karla", sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-hero-primary-content { display: inline-flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: inherit; } .ds-hero-primary svg { flex: none; transition: transform 180ms ease; } .ds-hero-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-hero-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hero-ink, oklch(0.97 0.007 75)); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-hero-primary { min-width: 224px; } } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-hero-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.84 0.075 75); } .ds-hero-primary:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero-primary, .ds-hero-primary svg { transition: none; } .ds-hero-primary:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Hero gallery action
components.description: Underlined secondary anchor with a 48px minimum target height.
components.css: .ds-hero-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; color: var(--hero-ink, oklch(0.97 0.007 75)); font-family: var(--font-body-family, "Karla", sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: rgb(245 244 239 / 0.5); text-underline-offset: 6px; transition: text-decoration-color 180ms ease; } .ds-hero-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hero-ink, oklch(0.97 0.007 75)); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-hero-secondary:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Hero playback control
components.description: Visual play-state sample. The application supplies play/pause state and accessible localized labels.
components.css: .ds-hero-playback { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(245 244 239 / 0.38); border-radius: 2px; background: rgb(12 14 12 / 0.6); color: var(--hero-ink, oklch(0.97 0.007 75)); font-family: var(--font-body-family, "Karla", sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-hero-playback:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hero-ink, oklch(0.97 0.007 75)); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-hero-playback:hover { background: rgb(12 14 12 / 0.85); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero-playback { transition: none; } }

components.name: Desktop navigation link
components.description: Desktop navigation item with the existing amber underline reveal. Full desktop navigation appears from 1280px.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 12px; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.92 0.008 75)); font-family: var(--font-body-family, "Karla", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 12px; right: 12px; height: 1px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 65)); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 300ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(0.82 0.08 75); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, oklch(0.92 0.008 75)); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-link, .ds-nav-link::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Desktop navigation action
components.description: Amber navigation inquiry anchor with Karla text and a 44px minimum target height.
components.css: .ds-nav-book { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 65)); color: oklch(0.10 0.010 55); font-family: var(--font-body-family, "Karla", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25rem; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-book:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-nav-book:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, oklch(0.92 0.008 75)); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-nav-book:hover { opacity: 0.88; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-book { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The inherited identity pairs deep charcoal, warm amber and pale type with the
existing chalet logo. Its source describes arrival at dusk: a warm chalet against
dark pine forest. Condensed display lettering gives the identity weight; lighter
body text keeps information readable.

The implemented hero is a scoped expression of that identity: supplied exterior
footage, a compact two-line property name and a clear availability action. Its
minimal composition and restrained response to input apply to this hero, not to
every future page layout.
keyCharacteristics: Inherited dark surfaces, amber accents and the existing logo.
Bebas Neue display type, Karla prose and JetBrains Mono data labels.
Hero-specific pale controls, static contrast shading and brief entrance motion.
dos: Do retain the inherited logo, Dark Timber palette and three font families.
Do keep hero copy and actions legible over both the poster and moving footage.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, stationary action hit areas and reduced-motion behavior in the hero and navigation.
donts: Don't promote the hero's two-line title, lower-left composition or 1600px container into a mandatory site-wide layout.
Don't add invented ratings, prices or instant-booking promises to the hero.
Don't replace poster-first compact playback with automatic video loading.
